questions.question: Describe Kilimanjaro: where it is, how high it is, and what kind of mountain it is.
questions.expected_answer: Kilimanjaro is in Tanzania, in East Africa, close to the border with Kenya. Its highest point, Uhuru Peak, is 5,895 metres above sea level, the highest in Africa. It is a dormant volcano that stands on its own, with snow and ice on top because it is so high.

questions.question: Name Africa's three largest lakes and one fact about each.
questions.expected_answer: Lake Victoria is the largest lake in Africa, shared by Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania, and is a source of the Nile. Lake Tanganyika is the longest freshwater lake in the world and very deep. Lake Malawi lies between Malawi, Mozambique and Tanzania and has many kinds of colourful cichlid fish.

questions.question: How would you find Kilimanjaro and Lake Victoria on a physical map of Africa?
questions.expected_answer: Kilimanjaro is a dark brown or white patch with a small triangle and the height 5895, in the north-east of Tanzania. Lake Victoria is the biggest blue shape in Africa, where Uganda, Kenya and Tanzania meet.
